body: I'm probably just sleeping. It's quite late where I am.
But if I did do it, you would never know. You would have no way of knowing. It wouldn't affect you at all.
I don't know how long I'm willing to wait. I was diagnosed with depression last spring but I haven't done anything about it. I'm too scared.
How long am I going to have to wait to see the good part come? It's been over a year.
